summary: PASS. Independently reviewed all 13 staged files against the requested deletion risks. Node closure is transitive and removes every incident edge; edge-only removal leaves nodes intact. Confirmation payload is exact and requires boolean true; preview digests bind project/workspace/kind/target plus current graph (or archived-project snapshot), and are rechecked under the graph/archive transaction. A pre-write graph snapshot is inserted before save; saved node-spec revision rows and project/workspace/files are not deleted. Archive checks active queued/running jobs, serializes archive/create-workspace with git/graph/registry locks, and job enqueue rechecks archived state under BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Generic /api/graph rejects any missing existing node/edge ID; only the confirmed removal path receives allow_removal. UI protects async preview with context, keeps stale-confirmation errors open, clears only matching scope state, and native dialog cancel/Escape cannot confirm. Ran the only permitted offline command: python -m pytest tests/test_removals.py -q -> 9 passed, 1 FastAPI/TestClient deprecation warning. The staged test file contains 9 Python tests and the inspected staged e2e file contains 6 UI tests; no claim of 34 Python/14 UI was accepted as evidence. For every reviewed staged file, SHA-256(index staged content) equals SHA-256(current worktree content); reviewed_hashes therefore records both identical staged/current source hash values. No source edits were made; this report is the sole created file.
